crosswalks.historical_boundary: Early-medieval Bactra/Balkh oasis, approximately 3000 km2 inside archaeological walls and site distribution
crosswalks.notes: The province selector contains eight EU5 locations and is much broader/different from the reconstructed oasis wall. No historical polygon overlay is available.

crosswalks.historical_boundary: Bukhara oasis inside an approximately 12×12 farsakh wall, with uncertain Paykent/Qaraqul fringe
crosswalks.notes: The EU5 Bukhara province is a game administrative grouping, not the archaeological oasis wall. The Paykent/Qaraqul boundary is explicitly hypothetical in the source.

crosswalks.historical_boundary: Middle Zarafshan valley from Waraghsar to the Bukhara-fan entrance, approximately 3500 km2 irrigated plus rainfed lateral zones
crosswalks.notes: The historical valley crosses multiple EU5 units and cannot be represented by the five-location Samarkand selector without an audited polygon overlay.
